name: Farmer's Companion
notes: v1.0.11: Fixed Auto-Water, Auto-Harvest, and Auto-Replant never syncing to other players in multiplayer (host-only local state change with no network broadcast, so clients wouldn't see watered/harvested/replanted crops until an unrelated resync). Fixed the Farming Range Boost slider not actually updating Auto-Harvest's radius (only Auto-Water honored it). Fixed a raw legacy input call that could throw every frame the menu was open on certain input setups.
